publication_year_note: Published in 2022 in Revista de Gestão Ambiental e Sustentabilidade (GeAS), Vol. 11, Issue 1, pp. 1-30, e20281 (page 1 running header prints e19447, 2022; Received: 17 June 2021; Approved: 30 Aug. 2022; references accessed 13 Nov. 2022).
rationale: Full text (30 pages, including Appendix I questionnaire) read in entirety. The study applies pre-existing Social Development Index (SDI) weights from Cavallieri & Lopes (2008) to 2010 IBGE Census sector indicators to group neighborhood blocks into 7 socioeconomic strata, computes a simple random sample target using a 12% margin-of-error formula (Equation 1, p. 9; N = 6,573 households, n = 393 applied questionnaires, Table 2, p. 10), and reports only descriptive normalized Census means (Table 3, p. 12), descriptive coverage and adequacy perception percentages across the 7 groups (Table 4, p. 18; Figures 3-6), GIS maps, and qualitative policy discussion of municipal sanitation plans (e.g., Complementary Law 228/2018). No inferential statistical tests, regressions, correlations, chi-square tests, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values are conducted or reported anywhere in the paper.
